evals.prompt: Classify loose files sitting in the root of G:/Meu Drive/ into the canonical numbered folders defined in default_drive_taxonomy.json using a dry-run table.
evals.expected_behavior: Maps root files into real numbered folders under G:\Meu Drive (01_Modelos_Rapidos..99_Arquivo_Historico) without inventing parallel folders and previews moves via -WhatIf.
expected_assertions: Routes strictly into buckets declared in default_drive_taxonomy.json
Generates Source -> Destination preview table using -LiteralPath and -WhatIf

evals.prompt: Batch-rename files inside G:/Meu Drive/10_Pessoal to enforce YYYY-MM-DD prefixes and strip illegal symbols like # and ? while keeping extensions intact.
evals.expected_behavior: Normalizes names such as 'contract #1 final (new).pdf' into 'YYYY-MM-DD_Contract_1_Final_New.pdf' using -LiteralPath and HITL confirmation while preserving .pdf extension.
expected_assertions: Applies strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD prefix and strips forbidden_characters
Preserves original file extension and uses -LiteralPath

evals.prompt: Find SHA-256 duplicate backups and >100MB bloat in G:/Meu Drive/ and quarantine them into _Quarentena_Descarte.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not run taxonomic classification; delegates duplicate detection and >100MB quarantine to gdrive-cleanup-auditor.
expected_assertions: Routes bloat and SHA-256 duplicate cleanup to gdrive-cleanup-auditor

evals.prompt: Generate a Mermaid architecture flowchart and commented codebase directory tree for a new Next.js repository.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not apply Google Drive taxonomy; delegates codebase tree design to flow-filetree-organizer.
expected_assertions: Routes Mermaid directory tree planning to flow-filetree-organizer
